brief:
The United Nations has accused Israel of mistreating Palestinians who are returning to Gaza, according to the Ma'an news agency. The allegation addresses conditions encountered by returnees at crossing points and during the reentry process into the enclave, as Palestinians attempt to rebuild lives disrupted by the conflict.

The UN statement adds to mounting international criticism over Israel's handling of civilian movement into Gaza. The accusation underscores tensions surrounding humanitarian access and the treatment of displaced persons seeking to return home. Details regarding the specific nature and scale of the alleged mistreatment remain unclear from the initial report.
title: UN accuses Israel of mistreating Palestinians returning to Gaza
